question: What placement is invoked for Kaulika to stand at the nose tip and likewise in the mouth of Madana?
premises: This verse states where a figure should stand.
She is invoked to stand at the nose tip and in Madana’s mouth.
inference: Kaulika is invoked to stand at the tip of the nose and likewise in the mouth of Madana.
plain_english: May Kaulika stand at the tip of the nose and thus in the mouth of Madana.
